title: United's next decision: What to do with all those Boeing 737 Max 10 seats it ordered years ago
summary: United Airlines is facing a significant decision regarding the Boeing 737 Max 10 seats it ordered several years ago. The airline had initially planned to install lie-flat premium seats on these aircraft, but the certification process has been delayed for an extended period. This situation raises questions about how United will adapt its strategy to accommodate the evolving market demands and the delayed delivery of these planes.
